# sdl3

**Tag**: web

## 简介

A Dart library for accessing common SDL3 (and SDL3_image, SDL3_mixer, SDL3_net, SDL3_ttf, SDL3_gfx, SDL3_shadercross) APIs using, FFI.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/sansuido/sdl3
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/sdl3
